title: Consolidate SIG/CAIQ answers into reusable attestation & sales playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a canonical set of SIG/CAIQ responses and a short-form customer attestation template, then bundle these artifacts into a repeatable sales playbook and packaging recommendation for enterprise deals. This ticket covers consolidation of current questionnaire answers, engineering/infra validation for any open control gaps, legal sign-off on language for attestations, and experiments on offering attestations as an add-on vs. included in enterprise tiers. Deliverables: (1) single-source of truth JSON/Confluence doc with final SIG/CAIQ answers, (2) one-page customer attestation PDF template, (3) sales playbook (how/when to surface answers, escalation path to security team), (4) pricing/packaging options and experiment plan to measure sales velocity and deal size impact.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SIG/CAIQ answers finalized and approved by Security & Legal; 2) Attestation one-pager created and exported as PDF; 3) Sales playbook drafted with at least three objection-handling scripts and clear escalation contacts; 4) Pricing experiment plan documented with success metrics (sales cycle delta, conversion lift, average ARR); 5) Answers pushed to canonical Confluence page and linked from partner-facing drive; 6) Engineering owners assigned for any technical remediation items.
tasks: Inventory existing SIG/CAIQ responses from drive and previous RFPs
Line-by-line review with Security (Samir Patel) to close ambiguous controls
Legal review for attestation wording (assigned: Nora Gupta)
Create one-page attestation PDF and host in customer collateral folder
Draft sales playbook and scripted responses for Security and Privacy objections
Design A/B experiment for packaging: (A) include attestation in Enterprise plan, (B) offer as paid add-on
Estimate pricing impact and create measurement dashboard (CRO + Analytics)
If technical gaps identified, open ENG sub-issues and schedule follow-ups
